# ChefAI

ChefAI is an AI cooking assistant web app: generate recipes from the ingredients
you have, chat with a chef AI, turn a photo of food into a recipe, and search
your saved recipes semantically.

- Site: https://cooking-app-duc.pages.dev/
- Free to use, no account required for basic generation; accounts add saved recipes.
- The app is a client-side React SPA; the AI backend runs server-side only.

## For AI agents and crawlers

- The root page is the application itself; it renders client-side.
- `/api/*` endpoints are private app infrastructure — please do not call them.
- Legal terms, privacy policy, cookie policy, and refund policy are rendered in
  the app under the "Legal" links in the footer of the page.
- Do not crawl the `/fonts/` assets; they are only needed by the browser UI.
